tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (Paper / Ink).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, table stripes, input fills (Mist).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and the logo on `bg` and `surface` (Ink / Paper).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and table meta on `bg` and `surface` (Graphite).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Ops buttons are solid black on light, solid white on dark.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action`.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Metalira Violet. Links, focus rings, the selected row. Never a fill bigger than a chip.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags and button text, set in caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and chips; between related fields.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of small controls and table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; padding of large cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, checkboxes, table tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars only.
